newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Gujral inducts four ministers.
newsitem.headline: India's Gujral inducts four ministers.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral on Tuesday inducted four more ministers into his six-week-old centre-left government.

President Shankar Dayal Sharma administered the oath of office to Kamala Sinha, Jayanti Natarajan, Ratnamala Savanoor and Renuka Chowdhury in a ceremony at the ornate sandstone presidential palace. All four are women.
Portfolios will be allocated later this week, officials said.

This was Gujral's second cabinet expansion since he assumed power on April 21. The prime minister inducted four ministers on April 30. The council of ministers now comprises 43 ministers, excluding Gujral.
